notes: MusicVerse now detects when the Supabase catalog is older than the bundled catalog and uses the bundled snapshot for that session instead of silently hiding newer records.
Catalog freshness checks compare stable Cover Album, Crazy Covers, SoundTrail instrument, SoundTrail recording, and SoundTrail style identities.
The remote catalog audit now compares only eligible Cover Albums, so intentionally excluded mixed-concert releases no longer appear as false missing records.
GitHub Actions now reports a missing Yellowdawg service-role secret as a skipped catalog sync rather than a successful sync step.
Accordion remains at 32 researched styles with at least three verified Spotify track examples per style from MusicVerse 0.7.4.
